q: What carbon data do aircraft and engine makers ask Queretaro aerospace suppliers for?
title: Queretaro aerospace: customer carbon asks
short: Scope 1 and 2 by site with year and method, a reduction target, and more often a footprint per part with material, machining and treatment shares. Build them from Mexico grid bills, gas for heat treatment and surface finishing, and metal supplier figures, and keep every number traceable.
audience: Machining, composites, harness and surface treatment suppliers in the Queretaro aerospace cluster

ul: Targets aligned with the customer's programme.
Part level footprints for key items.
Electricity for machining and clean rooms at Mexico's grid factor.
Natural gas for heat treatment, anodising lines and ovens.
Titanium, aluminium, nickel alloys and composites bought.

p: No material figures and no split between parts. Start with the top parts by spend or weight, then widen.

senseible: Senseible reads fuel, electricity and freight invoices into a dated, fingerprinted record per site, so each figure you send a buyer can be traced back to the documents behind it.

sources.label: GHG Protocol Corporate Value Chain (Scope 3) Standard
